description_text: Warm-hearted. Loves a caring ruler and hates cruelty.
Hard and spiteful. Respects a ruler who is feared.
Bold in danger. Admires a ruler who leads from the front.
Easily frightened. Obeys a feared ruler but does not love one.
Plain-spoken and fair. Values a ruler who keeps their word.
Sly and clever. Admires results and a little menace.
Up before the rooster. Respects good planning and firm orders.
Fond of naps. Likes a soft-hearted ruler, dislikes strict ones.
Keeps the old rites. Prizes honour and mercy, distrusts terror.
Believes what works. Judges a ruler by results, not titles.
Sunny and chatty. Spreads good news fast and forgives quickly.
Never satisfied. Grudgingly respects a ruler with a firm hand.
Wants to rise. Follows a capable, commanding ruler.
Happy with a quiet life. Wants peace, bread and kindness.
Stands by the crown. Values order and those who serve it.
Changes sides with the wind. Swayed by boldness and fear alike.
Will not be bullied. Resents fear, respects skill and courage.
Asks for little. Grateful for care and steady leadership.
